title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Chastain Park Amphitheater, Atlanta | 2003
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Chastain Park Amphitheater in Atlanta, Georgia, USA, on 13 August 2003.

It was the 17th show by the eighth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 35 dates between July and September 2003.

Starr had previously performed at the Chastain Park Amphitheater on 7 June 1992, 7 August 1995, 16 May 1997, 4 June 2000, and 13 August 2001. He returned there on 10 July 2010.

The eighth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Paul Carrack: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • John Waite: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, guitar, bass, harmonica, flute
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion
